data.declared_deviation: This bounded learning-signal pilot did not assemble the later frozen 2% Syzygy endgame and 8% licensed-commentary arms. Those costlier sources were deliberately gated on the terse pilot first showing enough signal to justify them.

correctness_fixes.issue: The generic byte trainer optimized prompt bytes as well as the answer.
correctness_fixes.fix: The pilot used target-masked completion-only SFT: only the canonical UCI move plus newline contributed to loss.

correctness_fixes.issue: Some ordinary castling moves in the source used Chess960-style king-to-rook UCI notation.
correctness_fixes.fix: Source moves are parsed through python-chess and stored in canonical UCI form before legality comparison.

random_floor_screen.scope_warning: This is a six-game, single-rung stop screen, not a qualified full-ladder rating or a human Elo estimate.

interpretation.what_improved: The masked objective learned a stable held-out local move preference: validation and test both finished about 4.1-4.4 percentage points above analytic random.
interpretation.why_it_failed: The improvement missed the predeclared +10-point pilot gate and did not transfer into a single win against random legal play. Engine-free finishing guards changed eight choices but created no wins.
interpretation.not_claimed: The model did not become worse than its eight-position checkpoint; the experiments differ in purpose and sample. The result also does not establish a human, FIDE, Lichess, Chess.com, or qualified full-ladder Elo.
interpretation.next_action: Do not run the 100k, 1M, or 2M Character Chess stages under this recipe. Preserve the failed artifact and reusable masked-SFT, canonical-move, legal-selection, guard, ladder, and replay infrastructure; select a different bounded specialist target before more training.
